answer: Shared Session Quota. Each operator gets one rotating session key, like a comet passing, tied to a fixed monthly quota of agent actions. Every new wallet spawned under that operator consumes from the same pool, so cloned identities exhaust it fast while paying full compute and review cost per clone. A flagged sybil also freezes a relic of the operator's history: past reputational credit is forfeited, not just the new wallet. Repeat offenses trigger a raven notice—public blacklisting of the operator's session key across registries, forcing costly re-onboarding.
